cards.card_text: Dry chaff A wandering sheep A fleeing deer
cards.verse_text: Would You chase after dry chaff?
cards.snippet: Would You chase after dry chaff?

cards.card_text: Straw and chaff Grass and flowers Smoke and mist
cards.verse_text: Are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a storm?
cards.snippet: Are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a storm?

cards.card_text: Chaff driven off by the wind A rock that never moves A vine climbing up a wall
cards.verse_text: For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
cards.snippet: For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.

cards.card_text: David asks that his enemies be like chaff in the wind.
cards.verse_text: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
cards.snippet: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.

cards.card_text: Asaph asks God to make the enemies like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
cards.verse_text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
cards.snippet: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

cards.card_text: They flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweeds before a gale.
cards.verse_text: He rebukes them, and they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweeds before a gale.
cards.snippet: …rebukes them, and they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweeds before a gale.

cards.card_text: Now it's Ariel's many foes who will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless like blowing chaff.
cards.verse_text: But your many foes will be like fine dust, the multitude of the ruthless like blowing chaff.
cards.snippet: …will be like fine dust, the multitude of the ruthless like blowing chaff.

cards.card_text: Then He says, "You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble." Friend, that's me mixing and stamping a giant batch for an HOUR, opening the oven, and finding nothing but crumbs.
cards.verse_text: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble.
cards.snippet: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble.

cards.card_text: The LORD tells the ones who conceive chaff that their own breath is a fire that will ___ them.
cards.verse_text: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble.
cards.snippet: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble.

cards.card_text: Nations are turned to dust by his sword and to windblown chaff by his bow.
cards.verse_text: He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.
cards.snippet: He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.

cards.card_text: It will be new and sharp, with many teeth, and Israel will thresh the mountains and reduce the hills to chaff.
cards.verse_text: You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.
cards.snippet: …will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD speaks: “I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.” That’s cookie crumbs on my counter with the ceiling fan on HIGH, and friend, you are NOT finding all of them.
cards.verse_text: “I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.
cards.snippet: “I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.

cards.card_text: Then the iron, clay, bronze, silver and gold are all shattered and become like chaff on the threshing floor in summer.
cards.verse_text: Then the iron, clay, bronze, silver, and gold were shattered and became like chaff on the threshing floor in summer.
cards.snippet: …the iron, clay, bronze, silver, and gold were shattered and became like chaff on the threshing floor in summer.

cards.card_text: The people making these idols will be like the morning mist, like early dew, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, and like smoke through an open window.
cards.verse_text: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.
cards.snippet: …be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.

cards.card_text: They even plan on selling the chaff with the wheat.
cards.verse_text: Let us buy the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the chaff with the wheat!”
cards.snippet: …silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the chaff with the wheat!”

cards.verse_text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
cards.snippet: …gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
